As a Blood Bank Manager, I want to register each blood component unit with a unique bag ID and expiry timestamp, so that inventory reflects usable physical stock.
Requirements: FR-002
Acceptance criteria: Given a new bag ID, saving valid group, component and expiry creates one unit. Duplicate IDs and expiry before collection time are rejected.
Dependencies: None

Description:
As a Blood Bank Manager, I want to view available units by group and component, so that I can identify shortages quickly.
Requirements: FR-002; FR-003
Acceptance criteria: Given a fixture with available, expired, reserved and quarantined units, the count includes only usable available units and updates after a reservation.
Dependencies: US-01
Acceptance Criteria: Given a fixture with available, expired, reserved and quarantined units, the count includes only usable available units and updates after a reservation.

Summary: Flag expiry and exclude expired units
Description:
As a Blood Bank Manager, I want to see units approaching expiry and exclude expired stock automatically, so that unusable units cannot be issued.
Requirements: FR-003
Acceptance criteria: A unit expiring within the configured 24-hour warning window is flagged. At expiry time it is excluded from availability and cannot be reserved. Timestamps are stored in UTC.
Dependencies: US-01
Acceptance Criteria: A unit expiring within the configured 24-hour warning window is flagged. At expiry time it is excluded from availability and cannot be reserved. Timestamps are stored in UTC.

Description:
As a Emergency Requester, I want to submit the required group, component, quantity and receiving location, so that the bank can start emergency fulfilment.
Requirements: FR-001; FR-005
Acceptance criteria: A valid positive integer quantity creates a unique request with emergency status and a current stock check. Invalid quantity or missing receiving location is rejected. A shortage records the unfilled quantity.
Dependencies: US-02; US-03
Acceptance Criteria: A valid positive integer quantity creates a unique request with emergency status and a current stock check. Invalid quantity or missing receiving location is rejected. A shortage records the unfilled quantity.

Description:
As a Blood Bank Manager, I want to atomically reserve usable units for a request, so that two requests cannot receive the same bag.
Requirements: FR-005; NFR-001
Acceptance criteria: When two concurrent requests compete for one available unit, exactly one reservation succeeds and the other reports a shortage. A forced transaction failure leaves no partial allocation.
Dependencies: US-04
Acceptance Criteria: When two concurrent requests compete for one available unit, exactly one reservation succeeds and the other reports a shortage. A forced transaction failure leaves no partial allocation.

Description:
As a Blood Bank Manager, I want to maintain verified donor eligibility, consent and location records, so that only suitable consenting donors can be considered.
Requirements: FR-004
Acceptance criteria: An authorized manager can add or update a donor record. Missing consent, unavailable status, expired eligibility approval or missing location excludes the donor from candidate selection.
Dependencies: None
Acceptance Criteria: An authorized manager can add or update a donor record. Missing consent, unavailable status, expired eligibility approval or missing location excludes the donor from candidate selection.

Description:
As a Blood Bank Manager, I want to filter donor candidates by approved compatibility rules, eligibility and distance, so that a shortage reaches relevant nearby donors.
Requirements: FR-001; FR-004
Acceptance criteria: Using a test compatibility configuration, include an eligible consenting donor at 10.0 km and exclude donors beyond 10 km, incompatible groups and ineligible donors. Use component-specific manager-approved rules.
Dependencies: US-04; US-06
Acceptance Criteria: Using a test compatibility configuration, include an eligible consenting donor at 10.0 km and exclude donors beyond 10 km, incompatible groups and ineligible donors. Use component-specific manager-approved rules.

Description:
As a Emergency Requester, I want to have a verified shortage trigger SMS alerts to matched donors, so that potential donors can respond quickly.
Requirements: FR-001
Acceptance criteria: With the mock SMS provider available, all selected candidates are dispatched alerts within 30 seconds of the verified emergency shortage. Record dispatch timestamps and provider results; retry does not duplicate an alert for the same request and donor. Provider failure is visible and is not marked delivered.
Dependencies: US-05; US-07; US-10
Acceptance Criteria: With the mock SMS provider available, all selected candidates are dispatched alerts within 30 seconds of the verified emergency shortage. Description:
As a Emergency Requester, I want to view the status of my request and its unfilled quantity, so that I know whether further coordination is needed.
Requirements: FR-005
Acceptance criteria: The requester sees only their own request status. Authorized managers see unit allocations and notification outcomes. Fulfilled status requires the requested quantity to be issued; shortage remains visible otherwise.
Dependencies: US-05; US-08; US-10
Acceptance Criteria: The requester sees only their own request status. Authorized managers see unit allocations and notification outcomes. Fulfilled status requires the requested quantity to be issued; shortage remains visible otherwise.

Summary: Enforce roles and audit sensitive actions
Description:
As a Blood Bank Manager, I want to restrict sensitive actions and record an audit trail, so that donor information and stock changes remain accountable.
Requirements: NFR-002
Acceptance criteria: Unauthenticated access is rejected. A requester cannot modify inventory or read donor contact/location details. A manager can perform authorized actions, with actor, action, entity and timestamp recorded in the audit log.
Dependencies: US-01; US-04; US-06
Acceptance Criteria: Unauthenticated access is rejected. A requester cannot modify inventory or read donor contact/location details. A manager can perform authorized actions, with actor, action, entity and timestamp recorded in the audit log.
